entries.prompt: 全身像，一只动物独自占据画面：它悬在空中、身体横向展开：a large wild carp with a pair of broad feathered bird wings spread wide from its back, a long scaled body, a blunt head, small eyes and a dorsal fin. well above the water, only sky and a distant shoreline behind it. strong backlight rimming every feather. Photograph, a view from slightly above and to the side, 85mm lens at f/5.6, fine surface detail, slight film grain, no digital sharpening, no text, no watermark.
